errors.evidence: The description uses the word "също" (also) to describe the green line, implicitly comparing it to the previously described orange line. The prompt explicitly instructs to avoid comparing the lines.

The description states that the labeled range of the x-axis is from 0 to 23. However, the visible axis labels (ticks) only go up to 20. The data extends to layer 23, but this is the data range, not the labeled range.
The description states that the blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.05 at Layer 0. However, the plot shows this line starting at a value much closer to 0, approximately 0.02-0.03.
The blue line representing the 'hidden state mean before gate' starts at the origin (0, 0), not at a value near 0.05.
The blue line shows a distinct drop from approximately 2.6 at layer 21 to approximately 2.5 at layer 22. Describing this as 'remains near' over-generalizes and misses this step-wise feature.
The orange dotted line, representing 'hidden state mean after gate', ends at a value slightly below 0.1, closer to 0.08.
The prompt explicitly instructs to avoid comparisons between lines. The word 'similarly' directly compares the trend of the green line to the previously described orange line.
The green solid line ends at a value visibly higher than 0.1, approximately 0.12-0.15. Describing it as '~0.1' is an inaccurate underestimation.
